user.title: HACF forum
user.description: Follows the topics of the French-speaking Home Assistant community forum (unofficial integration).

data_description.username: Optional: for the “My topics” list. Leave empty to follow only the latest topics.

menu.title: Forum notifications
menu.description: To see your notifications (mentions, replies, private messages), link your HACF account. This is optional and can be done later in the options.

account.title: Link your HACF account
account.description:
1. Log in to the forum, then open **[this authorization page]({url})**.
2. Click **Authorize**: the forum shows a long text.
3. Copy all of it and paste it below.

Access is read-only (topics and notifications). You can revoke it at any time in your forum profile: Preferences › Security › Apps.

data_description.payload: Paste the whole text, as is.

reauth_confirm.title: Link your HACF account again
reauth_confirm.description:
1. Log in to the forum, then open **[this authorization page]({url})**.
2. Click **Authorize**: the forum shows a long text.
3. Copy all of it and paste it below.

Access is read-only (topics and notifications). You can revoke it at any time in your forum profile: Preferences › Security › Apps.

data_description.payload: Paste the whole text, as is.

error.cannot_connect: The HACF forum does not respond. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown_user: This username does not exist on the HACF forum.
error.invalid_payload: Unreadable text: start again from the link on this page (a new link is created each time) and paste the whole text.
error.invalid_auth: The forum refused access. Start the authorization again.

abort.reauth_successful: Your HACF account is linked again.

data_description.topics: Topics kept in each list (5 to 50).
data_description.scan_minutes: In minutes (at least 5, to spare the forum).
data_description.news: Articles from the “News” section of hacf.fr, read every 3 hours.
